regions.today: Dry for the rest of the afternoon and evening with plenty of sunshine, in light variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Cold and clear tonight with patches of mist and fog forming in light northwesterly or variable breezes. Lowest temperatures of 0 to 4 degrees, with some frost forming in inland areas.
regions.tomorrow: A cool start to Sunday with mist and fog patches clearing during the morning to leave a dry, bright and crisp day with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees in light variable breezes.
